crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it…
“In that day there will be a spring opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
